plan.title: bug(lifecycle): AC-pass bank loses green-run evidence and reintroduces #3497

narratives.Description: A matching AC-pass bank still reports ok with an empty run list, so the green-run predicate is false and an adjudicable unquoted walk refuses scope:complete. Persist the green-run fact onto the durable bank and replay it; do not treat a matching bank as a green executable run.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`scope:complete` can still reproduce the #3497 loop when its completion-profile
`verify:ac` read is served from an AC-pass bank. The bank re-use object reports
`runs: []`, so an all-behavioural clause walk sees no green executable run and
refuses completion even though the literal acceptance commands just passed.

This occurred in a Deft consumer on `@deftai/directive-core@0.107.0` while
closing an already-merged story. Inspection of the published 0.108.0 package
shows the same bank re-use shape (`runs: []`) and completion profile
(`reuseMode: "bank"`); 0.108.0 was not installed or executed in the consumer.

## Reproduction

The active scope has:

- 12 derived, unquoted behavioural clauses, each bound to an existing artifact;
- executable acceptance commands;
- valid namespaced test evidence on every non-terminal plan item;
- merged delivery evidence (`--merge-commit` and `--pr`).

Run:

```text
task deft:scope:complete -- xbrief/active/<story>.xbrief.json --merge-commit <merged-sha> --pr <merged-pr>
```

The literal gate first passes its exact commands. The subsequent completion AC
walk then refuses:

```text
scope:complete refused acceptance — acceptance verdict (#3497): clause-walk-failed
clause walk read 0 verified, 12 unverifiable, 0 failed against 6 stamped command(s) and 0 run(s)
verify:ac FAILED (#3284) served_from=bank [rung=derived]
```

The durable bank record has a matching product-state hash and records the green
checkpoint, but it does not retain command runs. In
`tryReuseVerifyAc(...)`, the bank branch returns `ok: true` with `runs: []`.
`applyClauseWalk(...)` then calls `clauseWalkBlocks(...)` with
`hasGreenExecutableRun: false` because that predicate is derived only from
`result.runs`.

## Why this is a recurrence

#3497 intended that an all-unverifiable behavioural clause set not block when
executable acceptance ran green. Bank reuse erases the evidence that the
predicate reads, reintroducing the same refusal specifically on the finalize
path. Running `task verify:ac` again is inert because it refreshes the same bank.

This is distinct from #3584. Observed-behaviour evidence would broaden clause
coverage, but the immediate defect is that a valid green bank cannot satisfy the
same predicate as the green run it represents.

## Suggested thin fix

Preserve a trusted green-run fact in the bank snapshot, or make
`clauseWalkBlocks(...)` treat a validated matching green bank as the equivalent
of a green executable run. Keep failed clauses blocking and keep stale or
mismatched banks fail-closed.

## References

#3497, #3387, #3285, #3323, #3584

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-02T14:27:32Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Refutation of the recorded target on comment 5510981725 at SHA 3d8b42438d00bd8a504a79bc8f50d00fdf61ddb2. Input ceiling 5510981725.

The premise holds. I re-ran the composition. A matching AC-pass bank still returns ok with runs: [] ; hasGreenExecutableRun still requires result.ok && result.runs.length > 0 && every run ok; an adjudicable unquoted behavioural walk then refuses scope:complete with the filed string. The thin-fix OR cannot bind: treating a matching bank as a green executable run is a different, weaker predicate.

### 1. Matching-bank equivalence is not a green executable run — blocks-the-design

Evidence, re-verified at this SHA:

- AcPassBankRecord stores schemaVersion, scopeId, bankedAt, headSha, productStateHash, surplus fields, and postBankFindings. It does not store runs or executableRuns (`packages/core/src/session/ac-pass-banking.ts` AcPassBankRecord).
- maybeBankOnAcPass already receives executableRuns, then drops it. verifiedPass: true with executableRuns: 0 still writes a usable bank (#3558; maybeBankOnAcPass input comment; test "verifiedZeroRuns" in ac-pass-banking.test.ts).
- Bank reuse synthesizes ok: true, code 0, runs: [] for any hash-matching usable bank (`evaluate.ts` tryReuseVerifyAc bank branch). Cache reuse copies snap.runs.
- Current clauseWalkBlocks still blocks that zero-run bank. Temp composition at this SHA: #3558 zero-run bank + two declared unquoted behavioural clauses → servedFrom bank, predicate clause-walk-failed, 0 run(s).

Failure mode: binding "validated matching green bank ≡ green executable run" lets a #3558 zero-run verified-pass (clause tokens, empty floor relabel, or a bank written with no shell) excuse unmet adjudicable oracles at finalize. That inverts #3835: a bank that never recorded a command run covers siblings the static walk could not verify. Swarm complete reads this shared cache under `.deft/cache/ac-pass-banks`. Hash match already skips re-execution; the clause walk is the remaining check. Bank presence is not that check.

Disposition: do not bind the second arm of the filed thin fix. Do not teach clauseWalkBlocks to treat servedFrom=bank, reuse.kind=bank, or a matching productStateHash as hasGreenExecutableRun.

### 2. Persist the green-run fact the writer already has — sharpens-framing

Evidence: same temp composition, executed then complete.

- evaluateVerifyAcFromPath: ok true, servedFrom executed, 1 green run, two unverifiable declared behavioural clauses, bank written. #3497's excuse holds while runs are present.
- evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk with the same productPaths, and again with only `{ projectRoot }` as `scope/transition.ts` does: both ok false, servedFrom bank, predicate clause-walk-failed. Printed observed value: "clause walk read 0 verified, 2 unverifiable, 0 failed against 1 stamped command(s) and 0 run(s)" plus "verify:ac FAILED (#3284) served_from=bank [rung=derived]". That is the consumer string with N=2.
- reuseMode: "never" on the same plan: ok true, predicate executable-pass. Re-execution would pass; bank reuse is what drops the fact.
- 81 existing tests in bank-aware-complete, acceptance-resolver, ac-pass-reuse, ac-pass-banking, and acceptance-evidence all pass. None of them put adjudicable unquoted clauses on the #3387 complete=bank path.

Failure mode: the #3497 loop on the finalize path. Literal commands already ran green; complete then serves the bank and refuses; the standing remedy still says re-run verify:ac. Standalone auto reuse hits the same bank when DEFT_SESSION_ID is absent, so the remedy is inert. Same-session cache still has the runs, but complete's profile sets reuseMode bank (allowCache false), so it will not read them.

Disposition: bind only the first arm, recut. Persist a trusted green-run fact on the bank at maybeBankOnAcPass (the cache-shaped runs snapshot already used by writeVerifyAcSessionCache, or executableRuns plus reconstructed green runs). Copy it in the bank branch the way the cache branch copies snap.runs. Keep hasGreenExecutableRun derived from result.runs. Missing field on a v1 bank is not green: miss and execute once, then rewrite. Present executableRuns: 0 stays a zero-run bank (#3558 intact). Failed clauses still block. Stale or mismatched hash still miss. Pin the missing fixture: #3387 trial + declared unquoted behavioural clauses, complete served_from=bank, ok true iff the banked fact is a green run.

### 3. Do not flip complete to reuseMode auto — sharpens-framing

Evidence: resolveAcceptanceGateProfile("complete") is captureFromNarratives true, reuseMode bank, with the comment that completion never serves a same-session cache (`acceptance-resolver.ts`). resolveAcReuse prefers cache over bank when allowCache is true (`ac-pass-reuse.ts`). The repro still served bank and refused while DEFT_SESSION_ID and a just-written cache were present.

Failure mode: serving the cache at complete skips the narrative re-scan that profile exists for. A check-integrated or standalone snapshot captured with captureFromNarratives false would become the complete walk.

Disposition: keep reuseMode bank. Put the fact on the durable bank, not back onto the session cache.

### 4. #3387 fixtures do not contain behavioural clauses — footnote

bank-aware-complete.test.ts trial and #3558 git-status fixtures stamp commands only. They correctly assert complete=bank and executions===1. They cannot see hasGreenExecutableRun go false. This is why the suite is green. It is not a second defect.

### 5. #3584 is not this predicate — footnote

#3584 would mark unquoted behavioural clauses covered when typed observed_behavior evidence exists. The filed story has namespaced test evidence on plan items, which evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate already accepted before the AC walk. The repro clauses stay unverifiable: "cannot evaluate behavioral claim against shipped artifact". Covering them would also hide the bank/runs seam. Do not collapse this issue into #3584.

### 6. The printed remedy still names the wrong check — footnote

clause-walk-failed's remedy is the #3323 ship-or-rebind text even when failed is 0. SCOPE_COMPLETE_ACCEPTANCE_REMEDIATION still tells the operator to re-run verify:ac. Both are the #3497 message-loop half. Recut when served_from=bank and runs=0; do not treat this as a second engine.

### Injection / swarm

Triggered: shared acceptance state at finalize, worktree-local bank files, concurrent complete. Findings 1 and 2 are the lens. A forged bank already skips command re-execution today; hash match is the binding. Alternative B would additionally skip the unverifiable-adjudicable clause check. Persisting runs keeps the same trust model as the session cache (containedWrite + productStateHash). Do not take bank presence as the oracle.

### Road not taken

I considered flipping complete to auto because the session cache already stores runs and the same-session complete would pass with no schema change. That is the strongest reading of "inventory before a new field." What would flip: proof that complete's narrative re-scan is redundant once the product-state hash matches. The profile comment and the check-integrated captureFromNarratives: false path say it is not. Even then I would keep hasGreenExecutableRun on result.runs, not on servedFrom.

I also considered #3584 as the real fix, because covering the 12 clauses would drive adjudicableUnverified to 0. What would flip: if those clauses were undeclared, hence not adjudicable, so this bug could not fire. The filed refusal with 0 run(s) and served_from=bank only happens when some clauses are adjudicable. Declared unquoted behavioural clauses are that set.

### Rank

1. Drop matching-bank ≡ green-run.
2. Persist and replay the green-run fact on the bank; miss-and-execute when the field is absent.
3. Keep complete reuseMode bank; add the clause-shaped #3387 fixture.

The recorded causal claim stands. The filed OR does not.
